observations: September 17 Antares multi-year HALEU supply contract remains the newest material primary demand signal in cumulative evidence, adding a customer with prepayments supporting domestic enrichment expansion.
Together with the September 9 Radiant agreement, this supports broadening contracted demand while commercial-scale production remains the unresolved conversion test.
Binding customer additions and prepayments improve demand visibility but do not prove timely commercial-scale enrichment ramp, delivery qualification or unit economics.
Next decisive evidence is physical capacity expansion and qualified deliveries against contracted backlog.

unknowns: aggregate committed HALEU volume versus planned capacity

sources.use: binding HALEU demand and prepayment evidence
